newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault net debt rises, equity falls.
newsitem.headline: Renault net debt rises, equity falls.

text.p: Carmaker Renault SA reported on Thursday that its net financial debt surged to 9.39 billion francs at the end of 1996 from 3.37 billion a year earlier, while equity fell to 37.77 billion francs from 43.80 billion.
"This increase in debt was due primarily to the deterioration in the group's operating conditions and by the maintenance of a high level of capital investments," it said in its results statement.
The drop in shareholders' equity was due to the 1996 net attributable loss of 5.25 billion francs and the distribution of 837 million francs of dividends for 1995.
The company will not propose a dividend for 1996.
